facts.value: Explore the history of South Asia, from the Ganges River of India to the ancient cultures of Pakistan. Examining transdisciplinary issues of the past will give you a clear understanding of current and future matters in South Asia --- an understanding that will complement any career you pursue.
Bangladesh, India, Pakistan and other South Asian states and societies
Students have the opportunity to immerse themselves in the very cultures they are studying through Global Education programs.
The College of Liberal Arts and Sciences recommends these study abroad programs for students majoring in Asia studies with a concentration in South Asia.

communication and journalism, diplomacy, trade, and international organizations, food security, higher education, humanitarian service and philanthropy, intelligence, law and law enforcement, military, technology transfer, transportation and tourism
